title: A team update
passage: The first part of our project is ready. We still need to check a few details with the people who will use it. This week we will collect their observations, make the most useful changes, and agree on a practical date for the next version.
steps: Read aloud once in your ordinary way.
Choose one feature or tool to explore.
Read the same text again with that one choice.
Save one observation and one real-life use.
reflection: What changed in effort or meaning?
